title: Cofinal finite affine etale coverings of a quasi-compact quasi-separated etale object
statement: Let $U$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], viewed as an object of its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For every jointly surjective family of etale morphisms $(T_a\to U)_{a\in A}$, there are a finite set $B$, indices $a(b)\in A$, and affine schemes $V_b$ with etale maps $V_b\to U$, each factoring through $T_{a(b)}\to U$, such that $(V_b\to U)_{b\in B}$ is jointly surjective and every fibre product $V_b\times_UV_{b'}$ is quasi-compact. Equivalently, finite affine etale coverings with quasi-compact pairwise fibre products form a cofinal system of coverings of $U$. This is the refinement used in Etale Cohomology, Section 59.51, Tag 03Q4, for Sites, Lemma Tag 0738.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section 59.51, Tag 03Q4 (label section-colimit), first paragraph, using Topologies, Lemma Tag 0218 (label lemma-etale-affine) and Sites, Lemma Tag 0738 (label lemma-directed-colimits-sections)

proof.text: *Finite affine open cover of $U$.* Apply [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-scheme-cofinal-finite-coverings] to the open covering of $U$ by the single open $U$ ($U$ is quasi-compact and quasi-separated): there are a finite set $J$ and affine opens $U_j\subseteq U$ ($j\in J$) with $U=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j$. (Only quasi-compactness of $U$ is used here.) Write $\iota_j:U_j\to U$ for the open immersions.

source.place: Schemes, Lemma Tag 01IT (lemma-basis-affine-opens) and quasi-compactness of $U$; this is the 'finite affine open cover' of a quasi-compact scheme

proof.text: *Restriction of the covering to each $U_j$.* Fix $j\in J$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change] applied to the jointly surjective etale family $(f_a:T_a\to U)_{a\in A}$ and to $g=\iota_j$, the projections $p_{j,a}:T_a\times_UU_j\to U_j$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product]) are etale and jointly surjective. This is axiom (3) of etale coverings, Topologies, Lemma Tag 0217 (label lemma-etale), part (3).

source.place: Topologies, Lemma Tag 0217 (label lemma-etale), part (3) (base change of an etale covering is an etale covering)

proof.text: *Affine refinement over each affine $U_j$.* $U_j$ is affine, so [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-affine-refinement] (Topologies, Lemma Tag 0218) applied to the etale covering $(p_{j,a})_{a\in A}$ of step 2 gives $m_j\ge0$, indices $a(j,1),\dots,a(j,m_j)\in A$ and affine open subschemes $W_{j,k}\subseteq T_{a(j,k)}\times_UU_j$ with $U_j=\bigcup_{k=1}^{m_j}p_{j,a(j,k)}(W_{j,k})$. Put $B=\{(j,k):j\in J,1\le k\le m_j\}$, a finite set, and for $b=(j,k)$ put $V_b=W_{j,k}$ (an affine scheme), $a(b)=a(j,k)$, and $v_b:V_b\to U$ the composite $V_b\hookrightarrow T_{a(b)}\times_UU_j\xrightarrow{p_{j,a(b)}}U_j\xrightarrow{\iota_j}U$.

source.place: Topologies, Lemma Tag 0218 (label lemma-etale-affine): an etale covering of an affine scheme is refined by a finite one by affine opens of the $T_i$, i.e. a standard etale covering (Definition Tag 0219, label definition-standard-etale)

proof.text: *The $V_b$ form an etale covering refining $(T_a\to U)$.* (i) $v_b$ is etale: the inclusion $V_b\hookrightarrow T_{a(b)}\times_UU_j$ and $\iota_j$ are open immersions, hence etale, and $p_{j,a(b)}$ is etale (step 2); a composite of etale morphisms is etale [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](1),(2). (ii) $v_b$ factors through $f_{a(b)}$: with $q:T_{a(b)}\times_UU_j\to T_{a(b)}$ the first projection, the fibre square gives $f_{a(b)}\circ q=\iota_j\circ p_{j,a(b)}$ [def-pc-fibre-product], so $v_b=f_{a(b)}\circ(q|_{V_b})$. (iii) Joint surjectivity: $v_b(V_b)=\iota_j(p_{j,a(b)}(W_{j,k}))$, so $\bigcup_{b\in B}v_b(V_b)=\bigcup_{j\in J}\bigcup_{k}p_{j,a(j,k)}(W_{j,k})=\bigcup_{j\in J}U_j=U$ by steps 1 and 3.

source.place: Topologies, Lemma Tag 0217 (label lemma-etale), part (2) (composition of etale coverings), with Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GN (label lemma-composition-etale) and Lemma Tag 02GP (label lemma-open-immersion-etale)

proof.text: *Quasi-compact pairwise fibre products.* Let $b,b'\in B$. $V_b$ and $V_{b'}$ are affine, hence quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-spec-basic-opens-unit-ideal-quasi-compact](iii). Since $U$ is quasi-separated and $V_b$ is quasi-compact, $v_b:V_b\to U$ is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](1). Its base change, the projection $V_b\times_UV_{b'}\to V_{b'}$, is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](3), and $V_{b'}$ is quasi-compact, so $V_b\times_UV_{b'}$ is quasi-compact [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence](2). (Equivalently, Schemes Lemma Tag 01KO: in the quasi-separated $U$ the intersection of two quasi-compact opens is quasi-compact; the argument above avoids the reduction to opens.)

source.place: Schemes, Lemma Tag 03GI (label lemma-quasi-compact-permanence), Lemma Tag 01K5 (label lemma-quasi-compact-preserved-base-change) and Lemma Tag 01K6 (label lemma-composition-quasi-compact); Algebra, Lemma Tag 00E8 (label lemma-quasi-compact); alternative: Schemes, Lemma Tag 01KO (label lemma-characterize-quasi-separated)

proof.text: *Cofinality.* Steps 3--5 show that every covering $(T_a\to U)_{a\in A}$ of $U$ in its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site] is refined (step 4 (ii)) by the covering $(v_b:V_b\to U)_{b\in B}$ (step 4 (i),(iii)), which has finite index set, affine members and quasi-compact pairwise fibre products; this is the cofinality of the system of such coverings, by definition of refinement.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Section Tag 03Q4 (label section-colimit), first paragraph: 'U is a quasi-compact object which has a cofinal system of coverings by quasi-compact objects', the hypothesis of Sites, Lemma Tag 0738 (label lemma-directed-colimits-sections)
